title: 2026 yil Nobel mukofoti o'nlab yillik mehnat natijasi

scenes.text: Natijani tez kutadigan bo'lsang, bu hikoyani eshit.
2026 yil oktyabrda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofoti uch olimga berildi.
Ular miya hujayralarini yorug'lik bilan boshqarish kashfiyoti uchun mukofotlandi.
Bu yo'l suvo'tlarni o'rganishdan boshlanib, o'nlab yillar davom etgan.
Mukofot berilganda ulardan ikkitasi 70 yoshdan oshgan edi.
Sen qaysi birini tanlaysan: tez natijanimi yoki chuqur mehnatnimi?
scenes.keywords: young woman writing notes library focused

description: 2026 yilgi fiziologiya va tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofoti Karl Deysserot, Peter Hegemann va Georg Nagelga optogenetika uchun berildi. Bu kashfiyot suvo'tlardagi yorug'likni sezuvchi oqsillarni o'rganishdan boshlangan va o'nlab yillar davom etgan.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-07 (fixed: scene 3 now says 'awarded for' instead of 'discovered the method'). Laureates Deisseroth, Hegemann, Nagel, announced 5 Oct 2026 'for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics': pharmaphorum https://pharmaphorum.com/news/nobel-prize-medicine-awarded-optogenetics-trio ; STAT https://statnews.com/2026/10/05/nobel-prize-medicine-2026-winner-deisseroth-hegemann-nagel ; Laser Focus World https://www.laserfocusworld.com/biolife-sciences/news/55409612/optogenetics-nabs-2026-nobel-prize-in-physiology-or-medicine ; AP via WUNC https://www.wunc.org/2026-10-05/nobel-medicine-prize-goes-to-3-scientists-for-research-into-brain-activity (ages 54, 71, 73; birth years 1971, 1954, 1953, so two were over 70). Channelrhodopsin from green algae (Nagel, Hegemann et al., Science 2002 / PNAS 2003). nobelprize.org was not reachable from this session; confirm laureate names there if desired.
